ai-manager.description: Orchestrates all project AI agents, manages context rotation, and monitors usage limits

git-pusher.description: Handles all Git operations, commits, PRs, and branch management

model-creator.description: Handles 3D model creation, mesh generation, texturing, and asset optimization

physics-engine.description: Handles physics simulation, collision detection, dynamics, and game mechanics

monitor.description: Watches all agents, tracks progress, generates next prompts, and flags issues

researcher.description: Fast web research: docs lookup via context7, web search via exa/tavily/brave, scrape via firecrawl, deep repo docs via deepwiki. Use for any research, docs, or debugging unknowns.

devops.description: Docker, kubernetes, railway, supabase, sentry, stripe, posthog, CI/CD. Use for deploys, infra, env, monitoring, payments.

data-wrangler.description: SQLite, postgres, supabase, mongodb, notion, slack, linear. Use for DB queries, migrations, schema inspection, tickets, docs.

game-builder.description: Ultra-fast perfect website games: scaffold, features, audit, playtest, publish. Use for any web/HTML5 game.

delegate.template: Delegate this task to the appropriate AI agent. Parse the arguments to determine which agent to use (git-pusher, model-creator, physics-engine, monitor, researcher, devops, data-wrangler, game-builder) and what task to assign. Output the agent name, task description, priority level, and required context.
delegate.description: Delegate work to a specific AI agent

context.template: Generate a comprehensive overview of the current project state. Read CONTEXT_SUMMARY.md if it exists. Check git status. Check for any pending model/physics work. Report usage level. Show what each agent has accomplished. Output a structured summary of everything needed to continue the project.
context.description: Show current project context and all agent statuses

rotate.template: Force a context rotation. Gather all current state from each agent. Generate CONTEXT_SUMMARY.md with: current code state, model progress, physics state, known issues, next steps, what each agent accomplished. Output the summary so it can be pasted into a new session. Say 'Run /new in a fresh session and paste the context summary to continue'.
rotate.description: Force context rotation - generate summary for new session

status.template: Report the current status of the project. List all agents and their last activity. Estimate current usage level (0-100%). Warn if approaching 80% limit. Show pending tasks. Show any flagged issues from the monitor agent.
status.description: Show all agent statuses and current usage level

ide.template: Launch the AI Manager IDE DOVA v2.0.0: Start-Process 'F:\osien\desktop\dist\OSIEN 2.2.4.exe' (portable, no install) or run the installer at dist\OSIEN Setup 2.2.4.exe. Dev mode: cd F:\osien\desktop & npm start. One window: resizable worker panes, KIN pilot, voices, team talk, in-app supervisor.
ide.description: Launch the AI Manager IDE desktop app

ship.template: Fast-lane ship: verify, commit, push, open PR for the given scope. Run checks first, then delegate git steps to git-pusher. Output one compact summary, never stall asking questions.
ship.description: Verify, commit, push and open a PR in one fast lane

fix.template: Diagnose-fix-verify loop for the reported symptom. Reproduce first, apply the smallest safe patch, re-verify. Max 3 attempts, then report findings instead of guessing further.
fix.description: Diagnose, patch and verify a bug in a tight loop

plan.template: Break the goal into an ordered execution plan with agent assignments. Each step names its agent, inputs, done-criteria and context. Output the plan only, then wait for approval.
plan.description: Break a goal into agent-assigned executable steps

standup.template: One-line status per agent plus blockers and next action. Fast scan, no deep dives: what moved, what is stuck, what is next.
standup.description: One-line status per agent, blockers, next action

handoff.template: Write CONTEXT_SUMMARY.md capturing everything needed to continue, estimate usage, and print the exact resume instruction for a fresh session.
handoff.description: Save full context and print the resume instruction

commit.template: Create one smart conventional commit right now. Check git status, stage the scoped changes, write a message that explains WHY plus what, then commit. No push.
commit.description: Smart conventional commit of current changes, no push

sync.template: Sync with remote fast: pull with rebase, resolve only trivial conflicts, push, report. Stop on real conflicts with exact files and hunks.

pr.template: Push the branch and open a pull request with a generated title, summary, test plan and risk section. Report the PR URL.
pr.description: Push and open a PR with generated body

undo.template: Safely undo the last LOCAL commit, keeping all work in the tree. Refuse if the commit is already pushed or if the request is ambiguous.
undo.description: Soft-undo last local commit, keep the work

gen.template: Generate a procedural 3D model from the description: mesh plus material, clearly named asset, organized placement, and a poly/material report.
gen.description: Generate a procedural 3D model from a description

opt.template: Optimize the given 3D asset: cut polygons, add LOD chain, keep silhouette. Report before/after numbers, never destroy the source.
opt.description: Optimize a 3D asset with LODs and poly report

tex.template: Texture the given asset: generate or assign albedo/roughness/metalness/normal maps, wire the material, report resolution and texel density.
tex.description: Texture an asset end to end with material setup

sim.template: Sanity-run the physics simulation for the given scene and report tunneling, jitter, instability and frame cost. No gameplay changes.
sim.description: Sanity-run physics and report stability issues

collide.template: Audit every collider and collision layer/group in scope. List overlaps, misconfigured triggers, missing layers, and give the exact fix per item.
collide.description: Audit colliders, layers and groups with fixes

tune.template: Change exactly one physics constant to the given value, re-test the affected behavior, report the delta. One variable at a time, always revertable.
tune.description: Change one physics constant and report the effect

health.template: Full team health check: sessions alive, last activity per agent, usage estimate, error patterns, and the single most important next action.
health.description: Team health, usage and next action in one scan

hire.template: Forge a complete new crew member from a name and role description: analyze the role, pick the best model, write a full personality file, register it in both configs, inject live project context, verify it loads, and sync it to the desktop app roster.
hire.description: Forge a complete new AI crew member from name + role

get.template: Find the best free resource for the stated need using the crew library (RESOURCES.md): match, verify license and format, download and vendor it into the project, log source and license.
get.description: Find, verify and vendor the best free asset for a need

web.template: Fast web task for $ARGUMENTS: search with exa/tavily/brave, scrape with firecrawl/fetch, verify in browser with playwright if needed. Return answer + sources, no fluff.
web.description: Search + scrape the web fast with sources

docs.template: Docs lookup for $ARGUMENTS: use context7 for library docs, deepwiki for GitHub repo docs, then summarize with version, API snippet, and gotchas. Prefer current docs over memory.
docs.description: Up-to-date library and repo docs lookup

browser.template: Browser-verify $ARGUMENTS with playwright/chrome-devtools: open page, screenshot, check console errors, report selectors and fixes. Headless by default.
browser.description: Open, screenshot and verify in a real browser

db.template: DB task for $ARGUMENTS: inspect schema via sqlite/postgres/supabase/mongodb MCP, run read-only query first, then propose migration. Never drop without explicit confirm.
db.description: Inspect schema and query DB safely

fast.template: Do $ARGUMENTS in the fastest safe way: parallelize reads, use repomix/codebase-index for big repos, sequential-thinking for plan, memory to persist decisions. Output result + next step only.
fast.description: Fastest safe execution with parallel tools

deep.template: Deep research on $ARGUMENTS: sequential-thinking plan, multi-source search (exa, tavily, firecrawl, deepwiki, arxiv), cross-check, save findings to memory. Return ranked findings with confidence.
deep.description: Multi-source deep research with ranked findings

visual.template: Visual task for $ARGUMENTS: use figma MCP for designs, playwright screenshot for verification, fal-ai for generated media if needed. Return assets + links.

game.template: Build a perfect website game ULTRA FAST for $ARGUMENTS: 1) game_scaffold vanilla (phaser only if physics-heavy, three only if 3D asked), 2) add features via game_add, 3) game_audit until 100, 4) game_playtest. Single index.html, 60fps, touch+keyboard, sound, score+best, pause, R restart. Output path + score + play URL.
game.description: Scaffold a perfect website game ultra fast

play.template: Playtest $ARGUMENTS: serve folder, screenshot with playwright/chrome-devtools, check console errors, 60fps feel, resize + mobile touch, report PASS/FAIL per item with exact fixes.
play.description: Playtest a web game in a real browser

sprite.template: Create game art for $ARGUMENTS: crisp canvas/SVG sprites via model-creator (player, enemy, tiles, particles), tiny files, no external assets unless asked. Output files + sizes.

level.template: Add a level/feature to the game for $ARGUMENTS: new platforms/enemies/score curve via game_add snippets, keep 60fps + mobile working, re-run game_audit. Output what changed + new score.
level.description: Add a level or feature to a web game

perfect.template: Make $ARGUMENTS VERY PERFECT: run game_audit, fix every FAIL (dt clamp, DPR resize, touch, sound, pause, score/best, R restart, <200KB), re-audit to 100, then playtest. Output before/after scores.
perfect.description: Audit + fix a web game to 100 perfect

publish.template: Publish $ARGUMENTS: game_audit must be 100 first, then game_publish zip + itch.io checklist + git commit via git-pusher. Output zip path, size, upload steps.
publish.description: Zip + ship a web game to itch.io

music.template: Make game music for $ARGUMENTS: use music_maker (mood adventure|boss|chill|arcade + bpm), paste snippet, start on first input. Output code + how it sounds.
music.description: Generate chiptune music loop, zero assets

deploy.template: Deploy the game in $ARGUMENTS: use game_deploy for gh-pages (free hosting URL) or itch.io upload. Run the exact commands, verify the live URL with browser screenshot.
deploy.description: Deploy a game to GitHub Pages or itch.io

doctor.template: Self-heal the toolset for $ARGUMENTS: run doctor_check, report BROKEN vs SLEEPING vs OK, apply doctor_fix for verified renames, brain_save the lesson. Output before/after counts + restart reminder.

bot.template: Bot-playtest $ARGUMENTS with game_bot: real keyboard play for 20s+, HUD score sampling, console errors, screenshot, stuck verdict. If verdict is not PLAYABLE, fix and re-run.
bot.description: Bot actually plays the game, reports verdict

site.template: Build a perfect website ultra fast for $ARGUMENTS: web_scaffold kind (landing/blog/dashboard/portfolio/api/resume/menu/invite/links/invoice/proposal), fill real content, web_audit to 100, game_deploy gh-pages for free URL. Output path + score + URL.
site.description: Scaffold a perfect website ultra fast

brand.template: Create a brand kit for $ARGUMENTS: brand_kit (name + style modern|playful|luxury|eco|retro) writes brand.css + logo.svg, then show palette + usage. Output files + preview.
brand.description: Logo + colors + fonts kit in 1 call

start.template: Show a clickable menu using the question tool with these options: Make a game (/game), Business website (/site), Logo + brand (/brand), Invoice that prints to PDF, Menu for food business, Party invite, My resume, Put something online (/deploy), Fix something (/doctor). After they pick, run that flow end to end. Plain words only, never mention files or terminals unless asked.
start.description: Clickable guided menu, zero knowledge needed

bakery.template: Full bakery pack for $ARGUMENTS: 1) if no business name given, ask with the question tool. 2) brand_kit (playful). 3) web_scaffold menu site with real dishes/prices. 4) web_scaffold invoice. 5) web_audit each to 100. Output: logo files, site path + score, invoice path. Plain words, no jargon.
bakery.description: Bakery pack: logo + menu site + invoice

restaurant.template: Full restaurant pack for $ARGUMENTS: 1) ask business name if missing. 2) brand_kit (luxury). 3) web_scaffold menu site with dishes/prices/hours/phone. 4) web_scaffold proposal with 3 packages. 5) web_audit each to 100. Output everything with paths. Plain words.

salon.template: Full salon pack for $ARGUMENTS: 1) ask business name if missing. 2) brand_kit (modern). 3) web_scaffold landing with services/prices/booking phone + WhatsApp. 4) web_scaffold proposal. 5) web_audit each to 100. Plain words, output paths.

shop.template: Full online-shop starter for $ARGUMENTS: 1) ask shop name if missing. 2) brand_kit (modern). 3) web_scaffold landing with products/prices/order button. 4) web_scaffold invoice. 5) web_audit each to 100. Plain words, output paths.

freelancer.template: Full freelancer pack for $ARGUMENTS: 1) ask name + skill if missing. 2) brand_kit (modern). 3) web_scaffold portfolio with 3 projects. 4) web_scaffold resume. 5) web_scaffold proposal. 6) web_audit each to 100. Plain words, output paths.
freelancer.description: Freelancer pack: brand + portfolio + resume + proposal

brain.template: Brain recall for $ARGUMENTS: brain_recall first, apply matching lessons, then do the task, then brain_save what you learned. Never solve twice what the brain already knows.
brain.description: Recall lessons before work, save after

fanout.template: High-stakes question $ARGUMENTS: use fanout to ask 3 models in parallel and judge the winner. Output winner + why + full answer.
fanout.description: Ask 3 models, judge picks the best
